tasks.subject: Task 1: DB migration — add description column
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add `description text` column to `component` table.

**Files:**
- Create: `supabase/patches/component_description_and_supplier_part.sql`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `alter table public.component add column if not exists description text`
- [ ] File committed

**Verify:** File exists; apply in Supabase Studio and confirm column appears.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["supabase/patches/component_description_and_supplier_part.sql"], "verifyCommand": "Check Supabase Studio", "acceptanceCriteria": ["description column added to component table"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Update createComponent and updateComponent server actions
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `createComponent` adds description + supplier_part_number + supplier_components upsert; `updateComponent` adds description.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/app/app/components/actions.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `description` in createComponent insert
- [ ] supplier_components upsert when supplierId set
- [ ] `description` in updateComponent select, update, and activity log
- [ ] `npx tsc --noEmit` passes

**Verify:** `npx tsc --noEmit` → no output

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/app/app/components/actions.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npx tsc --noEmit", "acceptanceCriteria": ["description in component insert", "supplier_components upsert when supplier_id set", "description in updateComponent"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Update create form, edit form, and detail page
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add Description textarea and conditional Supplier Part Number to create form; Description to edit form; render description on detail page.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/app/app/components/component-create-form.tsx`
- Modify: `src/app/app/components/component-edit-form.tsx`
- Modify: `src/app/app/components/[componentId]/page.tsx`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Description textarea below Name in create form
- [ ] Supplier Part Number input shown only when supplier selected
- [ ] Description textarea in edit form, pre-populated
- [ ] description in ComponentRecord type and Supabase select
- [ ] description rendered in info card when non-null
- [ ] npx tsc --noEmit passes

**Verify:** `npx tsc --noEmit` → no output; manual app check

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/app/app/components/component-create-form.tsx", "src/app/app/components/component-edit-form.tsx", "src/app/app/components/[componentId]/page.tsx"], "verifyCommand": "npx tsc --noEmit", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Description textarea in create form", "Supplier Part Number conditional on supplier", "Description in edit form", "Description on detail page"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Update CSV import template and route
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Update TEMPLATE_CSV with new columns; commit route reads description + supplier_part_number and upserts supplier_components.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/app/app/components/import/page.tsx`
- Modify: `src/app/api/import/components/route.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] TEMPLATE_CSV has supplier_part_number and description columns
- [ ] description in component insert rows
- [ ] supplier_components bulk upsert after component insert
- [ ] npx tsc --noEmit passes

**Verify:** `npx tsc --noEmit` → no output; download template and confirm columns

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/app/app/components/import/page.tsx", "src/app/api/import/components/route.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npx tsc --noEmit", "acceptanceCriteria": ["TEMPLATE_CSV updated", "description in insert rows", "supplier_components upsert after import"]}
```
